tagline: Hand off or compact, keeping what you pick

features.title: Pick what stays
features.detail: A click on Wrap up offers Handoff or Compact. Either opens a card with the session's threads, read by Haiku, and fixed items such as files in play and open tasks; a click keeps or drops each line.

features.title: Compact
features.detail: The card writes the /compact instructions as you click and Fill prompt puts them in the prompt. You review them and press Enter.

features.title: Handoff
features.detail: Summarizes what stays through a hidden fork with the session-handoff skill, runs /clear, and fills the handoff into the fresh prompt.
